topic: 伏隔核的奖赏架构：Wanting vs Liking解耦，D1/D2 MSN时程效应，多神经肽社会奖赏整合

sources.citation: Berridge KC & Kringelbach ML. Pleasure systems in the brain. Neuron. 2015 Apr 22;86(3):646-64.
sources.role: 核心：NAc享乐热点定义，wanting-liking解耦，多巴胺不产生pleasure，affective keyboard
key_claims: NAc壳区前背侧内侧存在约1mm³享乐热点，µ/δ/κ阿片激动剂均能使sucrose liking反应翻倍
NAc'情感键盘'：前部appetitive，后部aversive，应激可重调
多巴胺增加wanting但不增加liking（帕金森病患者实验、多巴胺耗竭实验）
腹侧苍白球也有享乐热点，与NAc热点功能上相互依赖

sources.citation: Soares-Cunha C, de Vasconcelos NA, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Araújo R, Bhatt DL, et al. Nucleus accumbens medium spiny neurons subtypes signal both reward and aversion. Mol Psychiatry. 2020 Dec;25(12):3241-3255.
sources.role: 核心：打破D1=奖赏/D2=厌恶二分法；激活时程决定行为方向；κ/δ阿片共释放机制
key_claims: D1/D2-MSN短暂激活(1s)均产生奖赏；持续激活(60s)均产生厌恶
D1-MSN持续激活→强啡肽共释放→VTA κ-OR→厌恶
D2-MSN持续激活→脑啡肽共释放→VP δ-OR→厌恶
短暂激活机制：MSN→VP（GABA）抑制→VTA DA神经元去抑制

sources.citation: Mitchell MR, Berridge KC, Mahler SV. Endocannabinoid-Enhanced 'Liking' in Nucleus Accumbens Shell Hedonic Hotspot Requires Endogenous Opioid Signals. Cannabis Cannabinoid Res. 2018 Feb 1;3(1):54-63.
sources.role: 内大麻素-阿片系统耦合：eCB对liking的增强依赖内源性阿片信号
key_claims: NAc壳区热点内AEA（内大麻素）增强sucrose liking反应
同时注射纳洛酮（阿片拮抗剂）完全阻断AEA的liking增强
纳洛酮单独注射无效，证明基线阿片活性不足，需要eCB激活触发阿片信号
eCB和阿片在享乐热点内形成功能耦合

sources.citation: Borland JM. A review of the effects of different types of social behaviors on the recruitment of neuropeptides and neurotransmitters in the nucleus accumbens. Front Neuroendocrinol. 2025;77:101181.
sources.role: 社会奖赏的NAc多神经化学综述：OXT/MOR/KOR/eCB的分工与耦合
key_claims: OXT、MOR和eCB正向调节社会奖赏行为；KOR负向调节
MOR配对联结效应是雌性特异性的（Prairie田鼠，NAc壳区背内侧）
KOR配对联结效应是雄性特异性的
社会互动→NAc内AEA和2-AG上升；CB1R拮抗→阻断社会CPP
CB1R拮抗增加Prairie田鼠配偶拒绝行为（维持联结需要eCB）

sources.citation: Allichon MC, Espinosa J, Cole RH, Ko MC, Vanhoutte P, Joffe ME. Mu-opioid and nociceptin receptors show divergent, cell-type-specific actions in the mesocorticolimbic reward system in opioid use disorder. Front Cell Neurosci. 2026;20:1558963.
sources.role: MOR vs NOPR在中脑边缘奖赏系统的对立作用；治疗应用背景
key_claims: MOR激活（VTA区）增强DA传递→奖赏处理增强
NOPR激活（VTA区）降低DA细胞活性→减弱奖赏/动机
双效MOR激动/NOPR拮抗配体正在开发为低滥用风险止痛药

sources.citation: Robinson TE & Berridge KC. The neural basis of drug craving: an incentive-sensitization theory of addiction. Brain Res Brain Res Rev. 1993 Sep-Dec;18(3):247-91.
sources.role: 奠基性：激励敏化理论，wanting vs liking的原始框架

sources.citation: Berridge KC. The debate over dopamine's role in reward: the case for incentive salience. Psychopharmacology. 2007 Apr;191(3):391-431.
sources.role: 多巴胺=wanting（激励显著性）而非liking（享乐快感）的证据综述

sources.citation: Domingues AV et al. A novel perspective on the role of nucleus accumbens neurons in encoding associative learning. FEBS Lett. 2023 Nov;597(22):2545-2560.
sources.role: NAc D1/D2 MSN在联合学习中的互补角色综述

sources.citation: Sobstyl A et al. The ventral capsule and ventral striatum—Stereotactic targets for treatment-resistant depression. Front Psychiatry. 2023;14:1177392.

notes: 开放全文≥2篇综述（S1, S4）+ 原始研究（S2, S3）+ 2026年最新综述（S5）。核心机制有实验依据。享乐热点研究主要来自大鼠（Berridge lab），人脑推论需要谨慎。
